sources: Esri World Imagery z18 with the catalog site coordinates

values.note: FS: 16 campsites. The recreation.gov catalog lists 13: 11 take RVs (catalogued 25-40 ft; 004 and 007 at 40) and 2 are tent-only. 001, 007, 013 and 015 are pull-throughs. One camping unit per site. No agency length figure.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lodgepole-campground-gunnison-rd ('There are 16 campsites') + recreation.gov catalog 232155 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + notice 'Recreation Use Fee allows ONE camping unit ONLY', read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog 232155 (all sites STANDARD/TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC, no water or sewer attributes), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Water from a hand pump. Firewood $10 a bundle.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lodgepole-campground-gunnison-rd ('Water available at the hand pump'; 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; '$10 per firewood bundle'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lodgepole-campground-gunnison-rd ('Seasons of Use: May 23 - Oct. 1 (weather dependent)', last updated September 29, 2026), read 2026-10-28; the stored closes 09-12 was the end of the reservation calendar

values.note: A mix of reservable and first-come sites; the whole campground is first-come before and after the reservation season (2026: May 13 - Jun 18 and Sep 13-29). First-come sites are booked in person only. Booking closes 4 days before arrival; two nights on weekends (not marked soft). Extra vehicle $9 a night.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232155 (rules minWeekendStay 2, reservationCutOff 4; notice 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person') + /rates (2026 First-come 05-13 to 06-18, Peak 06-19 to 09-12, First-come 09-13 to 09-29) + FS page ('combination of first come, first serve and reservable campsites'; 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $9 per night'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $18 per camping unit per night; 2027 and 2028 unchanged.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232155/rates (2026-2028 STANDARD NONELECTRIC 18) + FS page ('Single Site: $18 per night'), read 2026-10-28

note: GMUG campground at ~8,840 ft in a lodgepole pine stand in Taylor River Canyon, 12 mi up Taylor Canyon Road (CR 742) from Almont. Across the road from the Taylor River (trout fishing, calm-water rafting); the sites are not on the bank. Fossil Ridge Wilderness lies a mile south. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 16 sites (FS), no hookups, vault toilets, potable water (hand pump), mixed reservable/first-come, $18 (2026-2028). Changed max_rig_ft 30 -> 40 (catalog; no agency figure) and season closes 09-12 -> 05-23..10-01 (FS). Added pull-through, booking.season 06-19..09-12, 2-night weekend minimum, 4-day cutoff. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored riverfront): every catalog site is south of CR 742 and the Taylor River is north of it. On Esri imagery the nearest sites (007, 009) are ~45-50 m from the bank with the paved county road and a day-use/fishing parking lot between; the river is ~30-40 m wide there. The stored note itself says 'Sits across the road from the Taylor River ... sites are not on the bank'. A road and parking lot between the sites and the water fail the open-apron rule, so riverfront looks unearned; river view at most.
